changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO person_notifications (person_id, notifications) SELECT DISTINCT office.person_id, notification.name FROM person_permissions office CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_REMAINING_VACATION_DAYS_CARRIED_OVER_MANAGEMENT_ALL' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_REMAINING_VACATION_DAYS_EXPIRED_MANAGEMENT_ALL' ) notification WHERE office.permissions = 'OFFICE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_notifications existing WHERE existing.person_id = office.person_id AND existing.notifications = notification.name );
